text:
jordan: ACME wants to kick off a 2-week POC tomorrow. Their InfoSec is asking for SOC 2 or a bridge letter + temporary evidence access. Can we provide a bridge letter + redacted SOC2 extracts and presigned S3 links by EOD? Need legal + security sign-off. cc @rae-legal @sarah-sec

rae-legal: We can do a short bridge letter that says the SOC 2 audit is in progress and an expected delivery window. I need: (1) confirmation of what evidence files we'll expose, (2) confirmation that NDA will be signed, and (3) security approval for IP/restrictions. I can draft the letter in ~3-4h.

sarah-sec: From security: we can support a limited evidence bundle + presigned URLs with IP restrictions and 48h expiry. NDA required prior to access. We'll redact any customer PII or production identifiers. We also want a download cap per link. :lock:

mike: Engineering can stage a temp bucket: s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1934123456-acme/ and generate presigned URLs once legal signs off on the file list. We'll scrub PII and remove console screenshots.

account-exec: ACME said they'll sign an NDA quickly. They only need logs + config snapshots (no runbooks). Also asked for expected SOC 2 completion date so they can justify internal timeline.

rae-legal: Audit firm estimates SOC 2 finalization by end of next month. Bridge letter will state audit is underway and provide an estimated delivery month. I'll prepare: (A) bridge letter (B) our standard mutual NDA template. Will send for review. Can we e-sign via DocuSign?

jordan: Proposed workflow: 1) NDA signed -> 2) legal posts bridge letter -> 3) security approves file list and IPs -> 4) eng generates presigned links with expiry/IP cap -> 5) account exec shares links with ACME. Sound good?

sarah-sec: Sounds good. Send me the requester IPs and requestor emails to whitelist. We'll enforce a 250MB total download cap and 48h link TTL.

mike: I'll automate presigned URL generation. Example internal command (will replace keys once file list is final):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1934123456-acme/controls.csv --expires-in 172800
```
I'll also add referrer/IP restriction via the proxy.

devops-bot: evidence-exporter deploy started -> image: evidence-exporter:1.3 -> build: 3951.

rae-legal: Drafts uploaded to legal drive and pasted below. Bridge letter is single paragraph + signer block. NDA is standard mutual NDA. Quick notes: we require ACME to sign before we issue links; bridge letter explicitly says "audit in progress, expected by [month]" and not a substitute for the final report.

account-exec: ACME prefers DocuSign, I'll kick that off as soon as Rae posts the docs. They also asked for a one-page "how to access" checklist to make internal onboarding easier. Can someone draft that?

jordan: I'll draft the one-pager (steps + small checklist for IPs, email, expiry) and post here in ~30m. Goal: get links out before COB. :thumbsup:

sarah-sec: Approving the following files for inclusion: controls.csv, kvmatrix.pdf, infra-configs/redacted-terraform.zip, app-logs/redacted/logs-2025-03-01.tar.gz. No screenshots, no raw console logs, no full playbooks.

mike: Got it. Exporter will include only those keys under s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1934123456-acme/. Starting export now. Will post presigned URLs once legal confirms NDA signed and Rae gives greenlight.

jordan: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. If legal posts drafts, I'll fold them into the one-pager and ping ACME.
